name: Fixture — column drift with no stretchy column
description: Two assertions against drift-demo.html. One selector is real; one is deliberately wrong, to prove that a selector matching nothing is reported as an error rather than passing silently.

fixedWidths.why: Every column declares a width and none absorbs the slack, so CSS table layout shares it across all of them — inflating the 44px checkbox column.
Deliberately wrong. Must be reported, never skipped.
